body.name: \mathcal B_H(\mathcal S)
body.type: finite set of admissible bidirected full-time edges
body.def: \(\mathcal B_H(\mathcal S)=\{\{(u,s),(v,t)\}:\{u,v\}\in E_{\mathcal S}^{\leftrightarrow},\ s,t\in\mathbb T_H,\ (u,s)\ne(v,t)\}\).
body.role: All bidirected placements allowed inside the observed window; their time separation is not bounded by \(L\).
